_comment: Cards that exist only for the as_cast test (tests/unit/casting/test_as_cast.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_as_cast_insight` is Lifestream's Blessing's first sentence on a cheap instant: draw X, where X is the greatest power among creatures you controlled as you cast it. `t_resolution_insight` is the near miss: the same `extreme_value` read at resolution, so a creature that leaves in response changes it.

cards.name: Test As-Cast Insight
cards.oracle_text: Draw X cards, where X is the greatest power among creatures you controlled as you cast this spell. You gain twice X life.

cards.name: Test Resolution Insight
cards.oracle_text: Draw X cards, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control.
